title: Create a resource
summary: REST API Development: Create a resource. Write a POST for another title.
introduction: POST sends data for the collection to handle. A successful creation often returns 201 and a Location header.
learningObjectives: Create a resource with REST API Development
Write a POST for another title

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Create a resource
blocks.code:
POST /books HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test
Content-Type: application/json

{"title":"Sun Trip"}

HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Location: /books/2
Content-Type: application/json

{"id":2,"title":"Sun Trip"}

blocks.text: The server assigns id 2 and advertises its URL in Location. The 201 status tells the client creation succeeded.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: Book 2 is created; its location is /books/2.

blocks.text: Write a POST for another title.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A repeated POST can create another item unless the API provides a duplicate-prevention rule.
